title: Installation and Development Environment
learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Installation and Development Environment.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.
Use official documentation to check details that depend on the toolchain or ecosystem.

overview_visual.alt_text: Roadmap for module 2, Installation and Development Environment.
overview_visual.caption: Representative milestones for module 2; all lessons remain listed in sequence.

notes: Install a stable toolchain, understand rustup/rustc/Cargo, and run a small Rust program. Use rustup to manage toolchains, rustc as the compiler, and Cargo for projects. The current course baseline is stable Rust 1.99.1 with edition 2024; confirm the currently supported stable release before publication.
